item.title: Why Are We All So Thirsty For Reality TV Again? | Straight Up with Kelly and Vlad
item.description: "Dancing With the Stars" is breaking voting records even after 35 seasons, cringe "Love Is Blind" clips are breaking the internet, and "Love Island" is still breaking hearts week after week. It seems we are having a reality TV renaissance. But what's behind it? Are we yearning for people to be "real" and "messy" in an online world so otherwise polished? Or are we falling for a trap? Is reality TV the furthest thing from reality of all? Vlad and Kelly are breaking it down in the very first episode of Straight Up. We love a good cocktail on this show, but please drink responsibly: this content is for listeners 21 and over, so know your limits, enjoy in moderation, and always plan a safe ride home.
